audience: marketers and customer teams who run referral programs with Referral Rock

useCases.title: Find your top referrers
useCases.text: The AI lists members with referral counts and rewards earned, and reads one member's views, shares, pending, qualified and approved referrals over a period.

useCases.title: Check which referrals are pending
useCases.text: The AI lists referrals filtered by program and status (pending, qualified, approved, denied), with the referring member and dates, and opens one.

useCases.title: See how much you owe in reward payouts
useCases.text: The AI lists pending payouts with recipient and total amount, and the payout transactions already sent with the balance left to cover them.

useCases.title: Review programs and their reward rules
useCases.text: The AI lists programs with their offers and share URLs and reads the reward rules of one: the trigger, fixed or percent amount, and payout type.

useCases.title: Add a member, or add or update a referral
useCases.text: The AI adds a member to a program, adds a referral for a member's code, or updates a referral's status, amount or notes. A qualified or approved status can trigger rewards.
